stop: Stop when every group's episodes have dec rows (generator cal/test 0-1999 for the cheap baselines, 0-499 for nuisance-SMC, H3/H4/H6/H7 0-499) or the day's owner cap is reached; these rows are the Stage C baselines table, the raw-posterior and conformal-selection certifiers, the alpha 0.05/0.1 own-guarantee table, per-fault-class and fault-shift analyses (docs/reviews/review_round0.md a-d).
_doc: Role baselines, review round 0 additions. Task `smc` (cfcap/baselines/smc.py:TASK) on generator episodes (--source gen: cfcap.gen.episode.make_episode ids, observed and labelled by the generator's own simrun), so capxfer and every other method share exactly the same cal/test/H* ids (review d). Each episode writes dec-schema rows per method incl. ep_n_faults and cand_fault_class. The certifiers added by the review are offline layers over those rows (scripts/baselines_pilot.py from-runs --split test --cal-split cal): raw posterior 5 % quantile (a), conformal selection at FDR 0.05/0.1 (b), SimultaneousLower at the methods' own alpha 0.05 and 0.1 + Mondrian per parent shape, per-fault-class strata and a doubled-fault-odds importance-weighted test (c). T2 rows for the same ids come from role stress. Total ~41 box-h, ~$7.5 at $0.18/h; unit_s are ESTIMATES until cfcap-baselines-pilot2 measures them. Every job is <= 33 min.

groups.name: b2-smc-cal
groups.pilot: ESTIMATE (2026-11-25): ~80 s per generator episode for all six methods (nuisance-SMC dominates; role nuisance's 20/40/70 s per pair/square/2x3 episode at 192 particles x 100 stages, x1.33 for 256 particles, + ~10-15 s for propagation, enum, capxfer, RLS). Replace with the measured nuisance_smc_s_mean etc. from cfcap-baselines-pilot2 (bl-canary unit sidecars) before submitting.
